why: Post-snapshot papers (arXiv 2504.07332, April 2025, 'On the minimal length of addition chains') report a new class of addition chains for which the inequality l(2^n-1) <= n-1+l(n) is proved to hold, extending the set of n for which the conjecture is known true; the general conjecture itself remains open.
